Object.Name: EXACT Reclaim
Object.Description1: LwM2M object to configure, execute and report the status of a sample reclaim on a device. The reclaim is executed through a direct (cellular) LwM2M connection only. Reclaimed data is reported through the EXACT Temperature object (ID 48932). For reclaims through LoRa, see EXACT Relay object (ID 48935).

Item.Name: Start time
Item.Description: Reclaim period start time in seconds since epoch.

Item.Name: End time
Item.Description: Reclaim period end time in seconds since epoch.

Item.Name: Reclaim
Item.Description: Execute a reclaim with the set start and end time parameters.

Item.Name: Status
Item.Description: Reclaim status: - 0: Idle or not in progress - 1: Reclaim started and in progress - 2: Reclaim finished successfully - 3: Reclaim error
